author: StewieFG
body:
Hello my lovely community :)
Lately, I have been working on a map for Avicade :D
I chose the name Hestrax, because D00ZiE suggested me that and it sounds really cool, so hail the doozie! xD 

special thanks to alexanderjoe10 for hosting the server


Name: Hestrax

Gamemode: Avicade, Minotour

Creators: EricV4

Screeenshots: http://imgur.com/a/iMFPk

Video: It's hard to judge minotour maps by only screenshots, and yeh, I recorded myself running and playing the map, lol. I hope you enjoy. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5F9e_NO2pwk&feature=youtu.be

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/xzizr8s0u6x5470/minotour.rar

YAML: http://pastebin.com/8YYYVPay

Thanks, and feedback is always appriciated :D

EDIT: just noticed that the video quality is really bad, i'm sorry for that :/
